evidence.observation: Reboiler reading ~440 °C, physically implausible versus 63-70 °C column profile, and it dipped to 320 °C at k=7 then recovered to ~435 °C — sensor/heater artifact rather than real process temperature
Column profile flat and stable (70 °C top section, 63 °C condenser section); little temperature gradient, i.e. weak separation driving force
Reflux and distillate flows near zero (0.0-0.2 / 0.0-0.9 L/h) with FYI702 ratio noisy around 6.4-7.3, briefly both zero at k=4-7

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature check (second thermocouple or calibration) and a distillate composition (GC) sample to determine whether any separation occurred.
